body.placement: own allocation (allocator class 0 or the v3 sup block); position independent; ARM

veneers.placement: cave.claim("dirtyclean.veneers", 24); must be within +-32 MiB of C0528954 (cave arena C072E064..C072EFB4 is)

sites.name: copy
sites.power_off_restore: declare as a 4-byte section with orig_word (SUP_BUILD_RULES §4)

sites.name: clear
sites.power_off_restore: declare as a 4-byte section with orig_word (SUP_BUILD_RULES §4)

sites.name: clean
sites.power_off_restore: declare as a 4-byte section with orig_word (SUP_BUILD_RULES §4)

arm_order: patch copy, clear, then clean site (each: write, read back, C000E91C + C000EABC)
disarm_order: restore clean site first, then clear and copy
keep body until reboot (DrawThread may be inside it)
filldma_interface: If a fill of a layer goes to the Fill DMA (projects/sys-perf/filldma): (1) clean+invalidate the target range BEFORE starting the DMA; (2) reach it through C0528B40 (so dc_clear_hook marks the slot) or set the slot bit in C_CLEAR yourself; dirtyclean then cleans the whole back buffer for that slot, and never invalidates anything.
